summary_en: The version check is a DfDocument class method. Retain a URL lock after obtaining its path; return3 for a non-directory input and return4 when its Alternatives component exists as a directory. That branch does not open native ProjectData under Alternatives; normal returns release the URL lock.

limits_en: Return3/4 enum meanings are unknown. The Alternatives branch is classification, not native ProjectData parsing.

limits_en: The lowercase projectData archive read does not establish the native uppercase ProjectData format, magic/header/schema or native failure behavior.

After finishDecoding_ma, Version presence selects checkDocumentVersion:currentRunningVersion:(decodedVersion,55000) on the DfDocument class and returns its actual int. Nil new info stores Cocoa259 only when errorOut is non-NULL and returnsfalse. Zero w0 from the setter also returnsfalse; no explicit restore occurs on that branch.

summary_en: After metadata setup, call _migrateARAFilesFolder:error: without branching on its result. If mAlternativeToLoad(self+48,q,8B) is not-1, send setActiveVariant: and reset the field to-1. No instruction rolls those changes back on later failure.

limits_en: Migration result is unchecked; runtime effects and rollback of activeVariant and field reset are unverified.

summary_en: Get projectDataURL(createDirectories=false), append bak and move(bak,main,errorOut) only when backup exists and main does not. A zero success bit restores old info and returnsfalse. On success, derive a metadata backup by deleting its extension then appending bak and move it to metadata(errorNULL), without checking that return. This load path can mutate files.
limits_ja: URL getterとnative moveの内部は未読。metadata backup move返値も未判定で、read-only loadは保証しない。
limits_en: URL getters and native move internals are unread. Metadata backup move result is unchecked; read-only loading is not guaranteed.

Pass actual selected/fallback data to setDisplayFileData: with no nil gate if both fail. Display errors are not stored to original errorOut and do not override data-loader success. This is not proof of a read-only/open-without-effects operation or a successful save/reload roundtrip.
